summary: More magic variables: inventory_file (inventory path and name), playbook_dir (playbook base directory), role_path (the current role's path, only inside a role) and ansible_check_mode (True when run with --check).
questions: How can a task detect that the playbook is running in check mode?
Which variable gives the directory the playbook lives in?
How do I reference files relative to the current role?
Which variable holds the full path of the inventory file?

answer_card.title: Path and check-mode magic variables
answer_card.answer_md:
- `inventory_file`: path and file name of the inventory.
- `playbook_dir`: the playbook's base directory.
- `role_path`: the current role's path (only inside a role).
- `ansible_check_mode`: `True` when run with `--check`.
